text:
Noah Rivera: Postbake check for rel v4.1.0: initial 15% roll (na-east 10%, eu-central 5%) completed. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Headline watch: rerank quality (precision@1), 99p latency, and 502 spike. Stop/go?
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Rollout r-20260322-410 -> v4.1.0 segments: na-east(10%), eu-central(5%). Fallback snapshot v4.0.8 created. Autoscale warmup active.
Tess Wong: copying. Running rerank regression suite (rerank-regress-2026) and per-route p95/p99 dashboards.
Diego Marquez: quick telemetry: precision@1 on sampled eval set dropped from 0.83 -> 0.78 in na-east after bump, eu-central unchanged. No latency/5xx anomalies so far.
SRE Pager: pause criteria: pause if 502s >0.5% OR 99p >2.2s sustained >5m. Standing by.
Noah Rivera: hold further ramps. @Deploy Bot pin fallback v4.0.8 and pause automatic ramps until we triage quality drop.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Fallback v4.0.8 pinned for r-20260322-410. Automatic ramps paused. Notifications sent to #product and #support.
QA Lead: rerun results: rerank-regress-2026 full pass? 45/50 pass; failing cases look like reweighting of signals post-quantization change. Examples:
```
Input: query "book a hotel"
Expected top result: "hotel-booking-skill"
Actual top result: "generic-suggestions"
```
Tess Wong: looks like feature scaling change in scorer after quantization profile applied. I can reproduce locally with quantize-config q8_fast.
Diego Marquez: possible mitigation: tweak scorer weights or deploy model with q8_compat profile that preserves score scale. Quick option: swap canary to q8_compat build v4.1.0-q8c without full model rollback.
Noah Rivera: decision: hold for 20m while we test q8_compat. If quality doesn't return within that window, rollback to v4.0.8. If 5xx/latency breach occurs rollback immediately.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Pausing ramps. Queued canary replace option: v4.1.0-q8c.
Tess Wong: running local eval on v4.1.0-q8c -> rerank-regress-2026 50/50 pass. Precision@1 back to 0.83.
QA Lead: smoke run on canary endpoints with q8_compat shows no 5xx, 99p latency stable.
Diego Marquez: patching rollout: replacing quantized variant in canary segments.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Deployed v4.1.0-q8c to canary segments for r-20260322-410. Replacing v4.1.0 in live canary segments. Rolling back plan remains v4.0.8.
SRE Pager: monitoring: no 502, error budget normal.
Noah Rivera: good. Go to rollforward plan: bump to 40% in na-east after 10m stable, then 70% global after 30m if metrics remain healthy. Documenting this thread as the stop/go log.
Product PM: updated release notes with a note about quantization profile change and recommended observability flags: https://confluence.redwood/release/4.1.0-note-q8c
QA Lead: leaving regression harness running; will alert on any drift.
Noah Rivera: thanks all. If anything crosses thresholds ping me and we'll flip fallback/rollback. :white_check_mark:
